While the Magic Quiver is equipped in the trinket slot, the player occasionally shoots a magic arrow that damages the first

in its path. Any overlapping monsters will also be damaged. When enemies are within 7-8 tiles of the player, a magic arrow is automatically shot straight towards the nearest enemy. Magic arrows cause some knockback and pass through all environmental objects (like

There are four types of Magic Quivers: regular, "Perfect", "Rapid", and "Heavy". The quiver's type will determine the possible values for the time between shots (X), minimum damage (Y), and maximum damage (Z).
The Magic Quiver is a random type when dropped, and it can be changed to any of four possible types if re-forged on an
. The generation rates listed below are the chances to obtain each particular type.

Cooldown is determined to the tenth of a second for the regular and Heavy types, and it is determined to the hundredth of a second for the Rapid type. For all types, damage is determined to the whole number. All possible values of both stats are equally likely for their specific types (e.g., a "Rapid Magic Quiver" has a 9.09% chance to have a 0.65 second cooldown and a 20% chance to have a damage range of 9-14). These stats are also re-rolled when the trinket is re-forged on an
, so it is possible to receive the same type of quiver with different stats.
